mechanism_narrative: The persistent decline in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT signals weaker weekday circulation, which suppresses retail footfall and keeps RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remaining below baseline and not recovering by at least 5 points from t-0w.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp fall in PARKS relative to prior weeks indicates fewer leisure trips and weaker discretionary outing intensity, which is followed within two weeks by lower retail-and-recreation visits.
candidate_trigger: PARKS drops below -20 after being above -10 in the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days after PARKS crosses below -20 from a less negative prior week.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM remains positive while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay depressed, routine essential trips substitute for discretionary shopping, pushing RETAIL_REC down over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM stays above baseline and both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of tightening movement restrictions first reduces transit access, then cuts retail visits with a one-week lag; the mechanism predicts weaker RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 2 points week-on-week while WORKPLACES remains below -10
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 days after TRANSIT weakens further while WORKPLACES stays below -10.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL rises and PARKS fall together, people are staying home more and making fewer discretionary outings, which lowers RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to decrease within 14 days even though RESIDENTIAL remains above baseline and PARKS stays below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS combined with modest recovery in TRANSIT marks warmer-weather leisure substitution, which pulls retail-and-recreation mobility upward over the next month.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -5 after two weeks below -10
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over 28 days after PARKS recovers above -5 and TRANSIT also improves.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in GROCERY_PHARM after a period above baseline indicates fewer essential errands overall, which should spill over into a short-run reduction in retail-and-recreation trips.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 0 after staying above 4 for at least two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not weaken within 7 days after GROCERY_PHARM crosses from above 4 to below 0.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remain depressed while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, remote-work substitution is dominant and retail footfall will keep drifting lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over 28 days even though WORKPLACES remains below -10 and RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline.
